# CANDIDATE: VIX_INTRADAY_MEANREV_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A rapid intraday VIX spike above its 5‑min VWAP often precedes a short‑term SPY pullback, offering a mean‑reversion short when price returns to the 5‑min VWAP. The edge exists because VIX spikes reflect short-term fear spikes that tend to revert, while SPY exhibits mean-reverting intraday price action during liquid mid-morning sessions.

## Mechanism

Compute 5‑min VIX VWAP. When VIX > VIX_VWAP_5min + 0.8 points and SPY price < its 5‑min VWAP, enter short at the close of the bar where both hold; require volume > 1.5× the 20‑bar average volume. Exit shape: Stop at the higher of (a) 0.3% above entry price or (b) the prior 5‑min high; target at 1R or when VIX falls back below VIX_VWAP_5min. Regime hint: Effective when VIX is between 12 and 25 (avoid extremes) and during mid‑morning (10:00‑11:30 ET) when liquidity is solid.
